notes: FEATURE: branded evidence viewer. Evidence links used to open the raw Supabase signed URL (https://<project>.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/sign/...), exposing storage infrastructure and looking unprofessional in demos. Added GET /evidence/:id, proxied/streamed (not redirected) so the address bar always stays on the PHF domain: server.js gets a pathname-matched route, and a new Vercel function api/evidence/[id].js is reached via a new vercel.json rewrite (/evidence/:id -> /api/evidence/:id) placed before the SPA catch-all so it isn't swallowed by the /index.html rewrite. Both entry points share one function, streamChecklistEvidenceDownload (lib/checklist-evidence.js): revalidates the session server-side, loads the checklist_violation_evidence row + its linked violation by id (id from the URL path only - no storage_path/signed URL ever accepted from the client), reuses requireViolationPermission(session,'view',...) unchanged (same scope logic as Admin/TRO_LY_GD/TBP/Truong ca/Quan ly truc tiep/employee already use for Nhat ky loi), mints a 120s-TTL signed URL purely for the server's own outbound fetch, and pipes the object body straight through via Readable.fromWeb (no full-file buffering, no signed URL ever reaches headers/body). 403 on out-of-scope, 404 on missing/deleted/orphaned-draft evidence or a missing storage object - no redirect on denial. Frontend (phf-checklist-app.js evidenceViewListHtml) now links/previews via /evidence/<id> instead of the old it.url; lib/checklist-evidence.js's listChecklistEvidence no longer mints or returns a Supabase signed URL at all (dead field removed, one less Storage call per list). No schema, bucket, upload flow, or permission-scope change.
